---
title: "Theory"
---

This section covers the statistical models implemented across
`masreml` and `masbayes`. Each page follows the same 7-section
structure: **Assumption · Linear model · GEBV calculation · Variance
component & h² · When to Use · See it in code · References**.

## Pages

1. [Biallelic & Multi-allelic](biallelic-and-multiallelic.qmd) — how
   the genotype matrix is built differently for SNP (biallelic) vs
   microhaplotype (multi-allelic) data, and what each construction
   feeds downstream.
2. [Mixed Model & BLUP Family (Frequency-based)](mixed-model-blup-family.qmd)
   — PBLUP, GBLUP, GWABLUP (Meuwissen et al. 2024). One MME, three
   relationship matrices.
3. [Bayesian Alphabet (Probabilistic)](bayesian-alphabet.qmd) — BayesA
   (scaled inverse-$\chi^2$) and BayesR (4-component mixture), sharing
   the same linear model.
4. [Continuous and Binary Trait](continuous-and-binary-trait.qmd) —
   what changes when the response is binary: liability-scale
   modelling, Laplace approximation in `masreml`, Albert-Chib
   augmentation in `masbayes`, and the observed-versus-liability
   heritability transform.

::: {.callout-note}
Every "See it in code" section uses the
[bundled demo dataset](../input-data/index.qmd) and calls only real
exported functions of `masreml` / `masbayes` (cross-checked against
the package source).
:::
